_: «Сила непостижимого» (Грин, 1918). Разбор и план — docs/stories/sila-nepost.md. Исходник с lib.ru: абзацы по отступу (format libru), первый блок — автор и название; эпиграф (Купер) — курсивом, главы I, II — заголовки (в ролике — интертитры).
art_context: A European city (French names; the country is not named), mid-1910s: a poor violinist's rented room; a picture palace with an orchestra pit; the study and laboratory of a learned doctor who is both a hypnotist and a researcher of colour photography (autochrome plates, a camera on a tripod, a heavy writing desk, an armchair by an open window onto a narrow lane); a narrow cobbled lane; a mental asylum ward. Clothing and objects of the 1910s: frock coats and lounge suits, starched collars, bowler hats, gas and early electric light, a violin in a worn case. No anachronisms.
